Top Fix #1 (Minor - Occluded sub-card headlines): Text-heavy sub clips have display copy sliced mid-word by the protagonist border — notably Act 4 BL ('Stop scrolling. Star...' in 04-06 and 'FoldLayers. Free on B...' in 07-10), Act 2 TL ('No new workf' in 19), and Act 4 BR ('...oad for Free' in 09). Selecting non-text/visual-only clip ranges for sub roles (especially FoldLayers) would avoid broken words competing with the hero.

Top Fix #2 (Minor - Near-black BR sub in Act 2 / dim TL in Act 5 at ~350px): In Act 2 (17-19), TR is vacant while BR shows very dark UI footage further darkened by sub dimming and bottom vignette, making the entire right side read almost empty at ~350px width (and Act 5 TL ProtoType in 12-14 is similarly faint). Using a brighter footage offset for Act 2 BR or slightly lifting sub floor brightness/vignette falloff on dark clips would strengthen perceived balance at README scale.

Top Fix #3 (Minor - Brief empty-corners beat at t21.75 & coverage note): At 11-t21_75 (Act 4->5 mid-handoff), all four corner slots are empty while incoming Act 5 is still ramping brightness (~70%), whereas 16-t5_50 (Act 1->2) already begins fading in new subs for smoother continuity; starting new-sub materialize ~0.25s earlier on Act 4->5 would match Act 1->2. Note also that Act 2->3 and Act 3->4 mid-handoffs occurred before t10.75 and t16.25, and WebP inter-frame compression/ghosting artifacts cannot be assessed from these pre-compression PNGs and must be verified on the final encoded showcase.webp.

verdict.summary: VERDICT: ACCEPT (layout & motion on v26 pre-compression PNGs). All prior critical/major issues are resolved: Act 4 hero footage visibly advances across t16.25-t21.75 (04-11), vignette is cleanly excluded from settled and mid-handoff protagonists (16-t5_50, 11-t21_75), the 3px blue accent border + dark keyline reads crisply even on bright yellow (Act 2) and off-white grid (Act 5) cards at ~350px, mid-overlap z-order handoffs cleanly elevate the incoming hero, and the rebalanced vacancy rotation (TL->TR->BR->TL->TR) eliminates persistent BR dead space with zero edge clipping, unrounded cutouts, or cross-canvas travel. Top 3 optional polish fixes by impact: (1) use text-free sub clip offsets for FoldLayers/Act 4 BR to prevent mid-word headline occlusion at the hero edge, (2) pick a brighter clip segment or ease bottom vignette/dimming for Act 2 BR (and Act 5 TL) so Act 2's right flank doesn't collapse into near-black at ~350px, and (3) start Act 5 new-sub fade-in slightly earlier around t21.75 to match Act 1->2 continuity (and verify WebP compression artifacts separately on the encoded file).
